ocr.notes: Gist readable; stake amounts ($250 forfeit, $5,000 a side) and 'stakeholder' garbled

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat, reprinting the Chicago Times, reported that Tom Allen came to Chicago and put up a $250 forfeit for a $5,000-a-side fight with Jem Mace set for May 20, 1876.

metadata.notes: Masthead: Saturday Morning, November 20, 1875; reprinted from the Chicago Times of Nov. 18

facts.fact: Allen travelled from St. Louis to Chicago to make the match with Jem Mace and planned to stay a couple of days
At 'The Store' in Chicago, Barney Aaron for Allen and Harry Hill for Mace deposited $250 a side with Mike McDonald and drew up articles for a $5,000-a-side fight on May 20, 1876
